title: vetdd judge verdict
description: Output of scripts/judge.sh: a blinded judge's scores for one or more candidates against a rubric. Candidate labels are opaque (c1, c2, ...). This schema is sent to the judge as codex --output-schema, so it stays inside OpenAI's strict structured-output subset (tests/verdict-schema.bats); rules strict mode cannot express (unique labels, one score per label, non-empty citations) live in scripts/check-verdict.sh.

name.description: The rubric heading this criterion grades, without the number.

evidence.description: The file path and line or quote that justifies the score.

verdicts.description: One entry per label: pass when every criterion scored 2, fail when any scored 0, otherwise partial; inconclusive when the judge could not observe the artifact.

winner.description: The label with the highest total, 'tie' when totals are equal, 'none' when only one label was judged.

applies.description: Whether the final evidence was produced under the agreed environment and run conditions.

disagreements.description: Places where the artifact's own claims and the evidence disagree, one string each.
